I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the…
It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in…
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn…
Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do…
Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.

translations.web: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
translations.bsb: The living, only the living, can thank You, as I do today; fathers will tell their children about Your faithfulness.
translations.kjv: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
translations.asv: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: The father to the children shall make known thy truth.
